Market today: The market is caught between persistent inflation concerns, with consumer prices still above target, and strong, ongoing demand for AI and chip technology. This creates a tug-of-war, especially for your tech-heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-43.37%) and SPAL (-40.44%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns hurt extra, and their default stops are currently *above* their prices, offering no downside protection. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on inflation data and any Fed commentary. Also, watch for continued strength in AI infrastructure and chip demand, which could provide tailwinds for your core holdings.

Bottom line: Manage your leveraged risk aggressively while staying alert for opportunities in core AI/chip names.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far above the current price of 144.13. Re-evaluate this stop immediately to protect against further downside on this leveraged position.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, your stop at 21.38 is above the current price of 14.98. Adjust this stop to reflect current market conditions and protect capital.
SMH: With positive chip news and a scanner WATCH at 585.97-585.39 (current 586.4), consider adding if it dips to the entry range with a stop at 584.25.
